games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'Shifting Currents, part 1': "They think it is clean," he muttered, pausing to pick up a straw. "But it is a _____ beauty."
rounds.answer: deceptive
rounds.explanation: The surface looks clean but is not, so the beauty deceives the viewer.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'Shifting Currents, part 2': "This is the _____ result of ignorance, not evil. And we have the power to change it."
rounds.answer: egregious
rounds.explanation: Egregious fits because Tariq is naming a shockingly bad outcome caused by habit, not by malice.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'Natural Resources Under Pressure': When the amount taken from the sea begins to _____ what the sea can replace, populations of fish shrink year after year.
rounds.answer: surpass
rounds.explanation: Surpass means to go beyond a limit: the catch exceeds what the sea can replace.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: What does 'naive' mean?
choices: sad and gloomy; not cheerful or happy
lacking experience or sophistication; easily fooled or deceived
a set of beliefs or ideas that are taught by a group or organisation
thinking you are better than others; proud and unfriendly
rounds.answer: lacking experience or sophistication; easily fooled or deceived
rounds.explanation: Tariq says some resisters are simply naive about the science: inexperienced, not wicked.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'Shifting Currents, part 2': Tariq rehearsed his speech with _____ effort.
rounds.answer: persistent
rounds.explanation: Rehearsing again and again, adjusting his tone each time, shows effort that continues despite difficulty.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'Shifting Currents, part 1': The _____ of respect is not science—it is carelessness.
rounds.answer: antonym
rounds.explanation: Grandfather corrects the debate: the true opposite of respect is carelessness, so the missing word names an opposite.

rounds.prompt: What does 'pristine' mean?

rounds.explanation: The sea only looked pristine at first glance; the word describes an unspoiled, original condition.

rounds.prompt: What does 'deceptive' mean?
